title: Remove UserProfileHeaderCard's redundant _user field and de-duplicate/select-narrow the active-profile lookup
why: _UserProfileHeaderCardState is a ConsumerStatefulWidget solely to hold _user, which initState/didUpdateWidget always sets to exactly widget.user -- functionally identical to reading widget.user directly, which would let this be a plain ConsumerWidget. Separately, the 3-line 'resolve active profile from the profile-list stream' expression (ref.watch(activeProfileIdProvider) + ref.watch(profileListStreamProvider) + .where(...).firstOrNull) is copy-pasted verbatim between this build method (lines 112-119) and _LocalBornProfileRow.build (lines 346-350), and neither uses `.select()` to narrow the read to just the active profile -- both widgets rebuild on any change to the full profile list, not just the active one.
recommendation: Delete _user/initState/didUpdateWidget and convert to ConsumerWidget; extract the active-profile lookup into one shared helper/derived provider (ideally using .select) used by both build methods.
acceptance_criteria: user_profile_header_card_l1_test.dart passes unchanged after the refactor.

corrections: Minor: second evidence line cited as 112 is actually 113 (activeProfileId line); the 346 citation is exact. 'Copy-pasted verbatim' slightly overstates since the state version has an extra 'widget.activeProfile ??' prefix, but the duplicated core lookup logic is real.
